name: ScrollTimeline
description: A vertical milestone timeline inside a smooth-scroll viewport: the line draws with scroll, and each dot lights up with a springy scale while its card slides in the moment the line tip reaches it.
a11yNotes: The viewport is a focusable role="region" with an aria-label, so keyboard users can Tab to it and scroll with arrows/Page keys/Space (native, unsmoothed) and see a 2px :focus-visible outline. Wheel input is smoothed only while the viewport can still move; at the top/bottom edge wheel events are released so the page keeps scrolling. Touch and scrollbar dragging stay native. Under prefers-reduced-motion (or smooth=false) the wheel is not intercepted at all. Milestones are an ordered list with real headings text and descriptions that stay readable (dimmed, never hidden) before activation; the line and dots are aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion cards and dots change state without sliding or scaling.

propsApi.name: items
propsApi.default: ['Idea on a napkin', 'First prototype', 'Private beta', 'Public launch', '10k teams onboard', 'What comes next']
propsApi.description: Milestone titles, one per timeline entry.

propsApi.name: descriptions
propsApi.description: Optional description per milestone, matched by index (missing entries are omitted).

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Accent color for the drawn line, active dots and labels.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the component's own scroll viewport in px (width is always 100%).

propsApi.name: borderRadius
propsApi.description: Corner radius of the viewport in px.

propsApi.name: lerp
propsApi.description: Interpolation factor per 60fps frame for wheel smoothing (0.05 floaty, 0.3 snappy).

propsApi.name: wheelMultiplier
propsApi.description: Multiplier applied to wheel and trackpad deltas.

propsApi.name: smooth
propsApi.description: Enable smooth wheel scrolling; false (or prefers-reduced-motion) uses native scrolling.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
